# Pabau

> All-in-one practice management software for clinics and medical spas with scheduling, patient records, payments, and AI automation.

Pabau is a cloud-based practice management platform designed specifically for aesthetic medicine, medical spas, and clinics. It combines appointment scheduling, patient management, integrated payments (Pabau Pay, Klarna), telehealth, and AI-powered features like Echo AI to streamline operations and improve patient experience.

## Key Topics

- Practice Management Software
- Appointment Scheduling
- Patient Records & Portal
- Online Booking
- Payment Processing
- Echo AI
- Telehealth
- Medical Spa Software
- Digital Forms
- Clinic Management
- Pabau Pay
- Patient Engagement
- Integration API
- Healthcare Compliance
- Aesthetic Medicine

## Core Platform Features

- [Appointment Scheduling & Clinic Calendar Software](https://pabau.com/features/calendar): Appointment scheduling with drag-and-drop calendar, staff views, and reminders.
- [Online Booking](https://pabau.com/features/online-booking): 24/7 online booking with Google integration and no-show prevention features.
- [Client Portal](https://pabau.com/features/client-portal): Client portal for intake forms, medical records, and patient engagement.
- [Digital Forms](https://pabau.com/features/digital-forms): Paperless digital forms and form builder for clinic intake and patient management.
- [Telehealth Software for Clinics & Med Spas](https://pabau.com/features/telehealth-software): In-system telehealth with secure video appointments for consultations and remote care.

## Payments & Financial Tools

- [Pabau Pay Card Terminals](https://pabau.com/features/transactions): Pabau Pay integrated payment processing with card terminals and invoicing.
- [Buy Now, Pay Later with Klarna](https://pabau.com/features/klarna-integration): Klarna integration offering flexible, interest-free payment options for clients.

## AI & Automation

- [Echo AI](https://pabau.com/features/echo-ai): Echo AI for transcribing conversations and automating patient management tasks.

## Integrations & Ecosystem

- [Pabau Integrations — Connect Your Clinic Tools, API & Workflows](https://pabau.com/integrations): Integration options with Stripe, Xero, Google Calendar, Zapier, and 30+ tools.

## Pricing & Getting Started

- [Pabau Pricing](https://pabau.com/pricing): Pricing plans starting at $62/month with details on Care Plus and Marketing Plus.
